ability.name: Tangle
ability.text: Throw it anywhere. Enemy animals underneath are stuck for 2.5 seconds and take 40 damage.

ability.name: Startle
ability.text: A deafening blast: 145 damage to enemies in the area and knocks them back 1.5 tiles.

ability.name: Irresistible
ability.text: Drop a snack anywhere. Enemy ground animals within 5 tiles go for it until it's eaten or 7 seconds pass.

ability.name: Patch Up
ability.text: Heals your animals in the area for 440.

ability.name: Sleepy Time
ability.text: Puts the enemy animal closest to where you aim to sleep for 4 seconds. Fearless animals are only slowed.

ability.name: Blaze
ability.text: 340 damage in the area, and hidden animals there are revealed for 5 seconds.
